# ST-1 FDS: Startup Sequence and Protection (Draft A)

**Scope:** states, startup sequence and protection for ST-1. The normal stop sequence, load control and generator electrical protection are separate sections (OI-12).

**Basis:**
- No setpoint list, cause-and-effect chart or alarm database was supplied, so the setpoint list, trip matrix and alarm list are written out here.
- Values marked "Given" come from your data. Values marked "confirm" are my proposals and need checking against the turbine vendor manual.
- Tables refer to setpoints by ID. No value appears in prose.

**Test method codes:**
- **TA:** force the input at I/O and observe the output.
- **TB:** shorten the timer setpoint and observe the timeout and failure response.
- **TC:** pull comms or cycle power and observe.
- **TD:** witness on the real equipment at SAT.

## 2. States and transitions (ISA-106)

| ID | State | Entry condition | Exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-ST1-001 | S0 TRIPPED | Any trip. The trip is latched and the steam valves are closed. | To S1: speed below SP-ZERO, cause cleared, reset done (Section 5). | Operator reset | Manual |
| FR-ST1-002 | S1 STANDSTILL ON TURNING GEAR | Speed below SP-ZERO. PT-210 above SP-LO-START. M-15 in auto and running. | To S2: START accepted. | Operator | Operator-prompted |
| FR-ST1-003 | S2 PRE-START | START accepted and all permissives true (step table). | To S3: step 7 complete. To S1: any failure before step 7. | Auto | Automatic |
| FR-ST1-004 | S3 ROLLING | Stop valve open, M-15 disengaged. | To S4: abnormal hold. To S5: speed within SP-RATED-WIN of SP-RATED. To S7: failure or STOP. To S0: trip. | Auto | Automatic |
| FR-ST1-005 | S4 HELD | Speed hold requested. A hold in the critical band is deferred until speed reaches SP-CRIT-HI. | To S3: operator CONTINUE and cause cleared. To S7: operator STOP or SP-T-HOLDX expired. To S0: trip. | Auto / operator | Operator-prompted |
| FR-ST1-006 | S5 RATED SPEED, NO LOAD | Speed within SP-RATED-WIN. | To S6: 52G closed. To S7: sync failure and operator STOP, or SP-T-NOLOAD expired. To S0: trip. | Auto | Automatic |
| FR-ST1-007 | S6 ONLINE | 52G closed. | To S7: STOP. To S0: trip. | Operator | Operator-prompted |
| FR-ST1-008 | S7 STOPPING | STOP command or sequence failure. The unit unloads, 52G opens, valves close and the rotor runs down. | To S1: speed below SP-ZERO. To S0: trip. | Operator / auto | Automatic |

Rules:
- **FR-ST1-009:** The DCS must store start type, standstill timer and turning-gear timer in retentive memory. *(TC)*
- **FR-ST1-010:** The DCS sets start type from the standstill timer: hot below SP-HOT, cold above SP-COLD, otherwise warm. If M-15 stops for longer than SP-TG-OUT at standstill, the DCS sets the start type to cold. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-011:** M-15 engages only when speed is below SP-ZERO and PT-210 is above SP-LO-START. M-15 starts automatically in S0, S1 and S7 when both conditions are true. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-012:** The turning-gear timer counts only continuous M-15 run time. It resets to zero when M-15 stops. *(TA)*

## 3. Startup sequence (S1 → S6)

Test method for every step: TA for the transition, TB for the timeout and failure response.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-ST1-101 | Operator pushes START and confirms the start type shown. | The state is S1, no trip is latched, and the turning-gear timer is at least SP-TG-COLD (cold start) or SP-TG-WARM (warm or hot start). | None (operator action) | Block START. Show the unmet condition and the remaining turning time. |
| FR-ST1-102 | Start P-11 if it is not running. | PT-210 is above SP-LO-START. | SP-T-LO | Abort to S1. Raise AL-ST1-001. |
| FR-ST1-103 | Check the permissives: P-12 in auto with DC bus healthy; PT-220 at or below SP-EXH-START; no active trip or alarm on XT-301/302, ZT-310; 52G open; Woodward healthy and comms good; steam supply, gland steam and cooling water permissives (tags: OI-01). | All true. | SP-T-PERM | Abort to S1. Show the first false permissive. |
| FR-ST1-104 | Stop M-15 and disengage it. | M-15 disengaged feedback is true and speed is below SP-ZERO. | SP-T-TG | Do not open the stop valve. Return to S1. M-15 returns to auto. Raise AL-ST1-009. |
| FR-ST1-105 | Reset the Woodward trip latch and open the stop valve. | Stop valve open feedback is true and no trip is active. | SP-T-VLV | Close the stop valve. Return to S1. Raise AL-ST1-010. |
| FR-ST1-106 | Cold start: ramp to SP-H1-SPD at SP-RAMP-A. Warm or hot start: skip to step 108. | Speed is at SP-H1-SPD. | SP-T-ACC1 | Go to S7. Raise AL-ST1-011. |
| FR-ST1-107 | Cold start only: hold at SP-H1-SPD for SP-H1-T. | The timer is complete and there are no active alarms on XT-301/302, ZT-310, PT-210, PT-220. | SP-H1-T + SP-T-HOLDX | An alarm is active: go to S4. At timeout, go to S7. |
| FR-ST1-108 | Ramp to SP-H2-SPD at SP-RAMP-A outside the band and at SP-RAMP-C or faster inside the band. Do not hold between SP-CRIT-LO and SP-CRIT-HI. | Speed is at SP-H2-SPD. | SP-T-ACC2 | Go to S7. Dwell in the band above SP-BAND-DWELL: trip (FR-ST1-209). |
| FR-ST1-109 | Hold at SP-H2-SPD for SP-H2-T. | The timer is complete and there are no active alarms (as step 107). | SP-H2-T + SP-T-HOLDX | As step 107. |
| FR-ST1-110 | Ramp to SP-RATED at SP-RAMP-B. | Speed is within SP-RATED-WIN of SP-RATED. | SP-T-ACC3 | Go to S7. Raise AL-ST1-011. |
| FR-ST1-111 | Hand over lube oil. When speed is above SP-MP-SPD, put P-11 in standby. | PT-210 is above SP-LO-START with P-11 stopped. | SP-T-MP | P-11 stays running. Raise AL-ST1-012. The sequence continues. |
| FR-ST1-112 | Energize the generator excitation. Start the auto-synchronizer. It closes 52G through the synchro-check relay. | 52G closed feedback is true. | SP-T-SYNC | Abort auto-sync. Hold at rated speed. Raise AL-ST1-013. Prompt the operator: RETRY or STOP. At SP-T-NOLOAD, go to S7. |
| FR-ST1-113 | Load to SP-MINLOAD at SP-LOAD-RATE. Hold for SP-MINLOAD-T. | The hold timer is complete and no alarm is active. | SP-T-LOAD + SP-MINLOAD-T | Hold the load. Raise AL-ST1-014. Prompt the operator. |
| FR-ST1-114 | Hand over to load control (separate section). The state is S6. | Load control accepts the handover. | SP-T-PERM | Hold at SP-MINLOAD. Raise AL-ST1-014. |

Hold rules:
- **FR-ST1-115:** A hold request below SP-CRIT-LO or above SP-CRIT-HI takes effect at once. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-116:** A hold request between SP-CRIT-LO and SP-CRIT-HI takes effect at SP-CRIT-HI. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-117:** The DCS must reject any speed setpoint between SP-CRIT-LO and SP-CRIT-HI as a hold target. *(TA)*

## 4. Protection

### 4.1 Lube oil pump control

- **FR-ST1-201:** P-11 starts when PT-210 falls below SP-LO-P11 and P-11 is in auto. P-11 stays running until the operator stops it. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-202:** P-12 starts when PT-210 falls below SP-LO-P12. P-12 stays running until the operator stops it. P-12 does not start M-15. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-203:** Both pump starts are independent of the DCS sequence state. *(TA)*

### 4.2 Trip matrix

Common effects:
- **E1 (immediate):** close the stop and control valves, open 52G at once, remove excitation.
- **E2 (sequenced):** close the stop and control valves. Open 52G on reverse power, or after SP-52G-DLY if reverse power is not seen. Then remove excitation.

All trips are latched and de-energize-to-trip. Armed means the stop valve is open or speed is above SP-ZERO.

| ID | Cause | Voting | Effect | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-ST1-211 | Speed above SP-OS-ELEC | 2oo3 speed probes (confirm, OI-03) | E1, no delay | Speed below SP-ZERO, cause cleared, engineer reset and overspeed acknowledgement |
| FR-ST1-212 | Mechanical bolt trips at SP-OS-MECH | Independent of electronics | Stop valves close by trip oil. DCS enters S0 and applies E1. | Local reset at the turbine, then as FR-ST1-211 |
| FR-ST1-213 | PT-210 below SP-LO-TRIP for SP-PV-DLY | 2oo3 proposed (OI-03) | E2 | Cause cleared, operator reset at DCS |
| FR-ST1-214 | XT-301 and XT-302 both above SP-VIB-TRIP for SP-PV-DLY, at any bearing | 2oo2 per bearing (Given) | E2 | Speed below SP-ZERO, cause cleared, engineer reset |
| FR-ST1-215 | ZT-310 magnitude above SP-THR-TRIP for SP-PV-DLY, either direction | 2oo3 proposed (OI-03) | E2 | Speed below SP-ZERO, cause cleared, engineer reset |
| FR-ST1-216 | PT-220 above SP-EXH-TRIP for SP-PV-DLY (loss of vacuum) | 2oo3 proposed (OI-03) | E2 | Cause cleared, operator reset at DCS |
| FR-ST1-217 | Loss of all speed signals, or Woodward controller failure | Hardwired watchdog | E1 | Engineer reset |
| FR-ST1-218 | Emergency pushbutton (tag: OI-01) | 1oo1 | E1 | Operator reset after releasing the pushbutton |
| FR-ST1-219 | Time in critical band above SP-BAND-DWELL | Timer | E2 | Operator reset at DCS |
| FR-ST1-220 | Generator protection trip (86G, external) | External | E1 | Per generator protection section |

All of these are tested by TA at FAT. FR-ST1-211, 212 and 217 are also tested by TD at SAT.

Allocation requirements:
- **FR-ST1-221:** Trip logic runs outside the DCS, on hardwired inputs to the Woodward controller or a dedicated trip system. DCS failure must not prevent a trip. *(TC)*
- **FR-ST1-222:** The DCS records the first-out trip cause and time. The record stays until the operator resets the trip. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-223:** If the SRS allocates any function in this table to a safety instrumented function, the SRS governs that function and this row becomes a reference (OI-04). *(Document review)*

### 4.3 Bad-quality inputs

- **FR-ST1-231:** A transmitter in a 2oo3 group with bad quality for SP-BAD-DLY is removed from the vote. The vote becomes 1oo2. The DCS raises an alarm. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-232:** If two transmitters in a 2oo3 group are bad, the function trips when armed. When not armed, the function blocks START. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-233:** If one probe of a 2oo2 vibration pair is bad, the vote becomes 1oo1 on the healthy probe. If both probes are bad, the function trips when armed and blocks START when not armed. *(TA)*

### 4.4 Alarms

No alarm database was supplied. Priorities are provisional. Alarm limits are in the setpoint list.

| ID | Tag | Condition | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AL-ST1-001 | PT-210 | Below SP-LO-ALM, or not established at step 102 | High | Check P-11. Check for leaks. |
| AL-ST1-002 | P-11 | Auto-started | Medium | Find the cause of low pressure. |
| AL-ST1-003 | P-12 | Auto-started | High | Prepare for trip. Find the cause. |
| AL-ST1-004 | XT-301/302 | Above SP-VIB-ALM | High | Hold speed. Check trend. |
| AL-ST1-005 | ZT-310 | Magnitude above SP-THR-ALM | High | Reduce load. Check trend. |
| AL-ST1-006 | PT-220 | Above SP-EXH-ALM | High | Check condenser vacuum. |
| AL-ST1-007 | ST-1 | Trip (first-out cause shown) | Critical | Follow the trip procedure. |
| AL-ST1-008 | ST-1 | Mechanical trip or stop valve closed unexpectedly | Critical | Check the turbine locally. |
| AL-ST1-009 | M-15 | Disengage failed, or stopped while required | High | Check M-15 locally. |
| AL-ST1-010 | ST-1 | Trip reset or valve open failed | High | Check the trip oil system. |
| AL-ST1-011 | ST-1 | Acceleration timeout | High | Check steam supply and governor. |
| AL-ST1-012 | P-11 | Shaft pump takeover failed | Medium | Check the shaft-driven pump. |
| AL-ST1-013 | 52G | Auto-sync timeout | High | Choose RETRY or STOP. |
| AL-ST1-014 | ST-1 | Initial loading timeout | Medium | Check load demand. |
| AL-ST1-015 | DCS–Woodward | Comms lost | High | Go to the local panel. |

## 5. Abnormal handling

| ID | Event | Required behavior | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-ST1-301 | DCS–Woodward comms lost longer than SP-COMMS | Woodward keeps its protection and holds speed, or load online. In the critical band, it continues to SP-CRIT-HI first. The DCS raises AL-ST1-015. The sequence stops advancing until comms return and the operator confirms. | TC |
| FR-ST1-302 | DCS power loss and restart | Trip functions stay active (FR-ST1-221). On restart, the DCS reads the retained state and the field state. It does not resume a sequence step. Rotor at standstill with no trip: S1. Unit online (52G closed): S6. Unit at speed with 52G open: S4, with an operator prompt. | TC |
| FR-ST1-303 | AC power loss with the unit running | P-11 and M-15 stop. P-12 starts at SP-LO-P12 and runs through rundown. The trip at SP-LO-TRIP stays active. | TA, TD |
| FR-ST1-304 | AC power returns | P-11 and M-15 restart automatically at standstill if the conditions of FR-ST1-011 are true. The unit stays in S0 or S1 until the operator acts. | TC |
| FR-ST1-305 | M-15 stops at standstill | The DCS raises AL-ST1-009. The turning-gear timer resets. FR-ST1-010 applies to the next start. | TA |
| FR-ST1-306 | PT-210 below SP-LO-TRIP while on turning gear | M-15 stops and stays stopped until PT-210 is above SP-LO-START (confirm, OI-08). | TA |
| FR-ST1-307 | Fail positions | Stop valves and control valves fail closed. Trip outputs fail to trip. 52G opens on loss of the trip signal path (OI-10). M-15 and P-11 fail stopped. P-12 starts on its own pressure switch or low-pressure logic. | TA, TD |

## 6. Operator interface

- **FR-ST1-401:** The ST-1 faceplate shows the state, the start type, the turning-gear timer and the active hold timer. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-402:** The operator gets a prompt for: START confirm, CONTINUE or STOP in S4, RETRY or STOP after a sync failure, and trip reset. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-403:** Trip reset for FR-ST1-211, 212, 214, 215 and 217 needs an engineer login. *(TA)*
- **FR-ST1-404:** Operations signs off the states, prompts and alarm priorities before FAT. *(Document review)*
